# AIS-DATA-02

**Is retrieval trimmed to what the caller may see?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [AI solution lens](ai-solution.md) 0.4.0 |
| Area | DATA: Grounding and data |
| Default severity | blocker |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `elements.ai.grounding.access_control`, `data.classification` |

## Why it matters

A shared index without per-caller access control discloses across users and tenants.

## Rule

When any grounding source is confidential, restricted or personal, access_control is document-level or caller-permission-trimmed.

## Sources

- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, LLM09 Vector and Embedding Weaknesses (`owasp-llm09`)
- OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2026, LLM02 Sensitive Information Disclosure (`owasp-llm02`)
